summary.text: Noelle Kahaian is a Republican state representative from Georgia House District 81 who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A paralegal, she succeeded Democrat Scott Holcomb in the seat.

paragraphs.text: Kahaian earned a bachelor's degree from William Tyndale College and a degree from Oakland University, and her career experience includes working as a paralegal.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she earned a bachelor's degree in psychology, completed an ABA-approved paralegal certificate and works as a paralegal for the nonprofit Child & Parental Rights Campaign.
She said she co-founded Protect Student Health Georgia and volunteers with the Georgia Eagle Forum.
Kahaian assumed office in the Georgia House on January 13, 2025, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Defense and Veterans Affairs Committee, the Energy, Utilities and Telecommunications Committee and the State Planning and Community Affairs Committee.
In the survey, she listed her campaign messages as eliminating property taxes, lowering costs and inflation, and strengthening public safety and schools.
